fields.description: Issue includes investigative and editorial coverage alleging an illegal gambling “syndicate”/monopoly operating in Miami Beach with political and police protection, including discussion of concessions and tribute payments. Continues extensive reporting on “Dr. T. E. Moore” (the “Torture Doctor”), printing correspondence and court-record-based allegations from multiple wives involving cruelty and related legal actions. Publishes a detailed Salvation Army reply addressing fundraising, finances, and services, plus additional local commentary and entertainment/music columns and advertisements.
